records.name: Hollis Sample
records.biography_en: Hollis Sample serves with the Sample Detail of The Spore Detail. The kit includes a small capped glass sample tube in a thick olive cradle. Hypernormalization assignments send the crew where a dangerous card or an incident has unsettled a district.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Hollis Sample treats the equipment check as the first useful part of every briefing.
